results.title: Neural-Network-Based Optimal Impedance Control for Robots in Physical Interaction With Soft Environments
results.venue: IEEE Transactions on Systems, Man, and Cybernetics: Systems
results.abstract: A Hunt-Crossley soft-environment law is identified from interaction data, then an uncertainty-aware nonlinear optimal-control problem is approximated by a critic network to adapt impedance; validation is one-dimensional and assumes prior identification with fixed environment parameters during a trial.

results.title: Closing the learning-planning loop with predictive state representations
results.venue: The International Journal of Robotics Research
results.abstract: A spectral algorithm learns a compact predictive state directly from action-observation sequences and closes the loop by planning in that state; consistency and compactness depend on the stated structural, rank, and sampling assumptions.

results.title: Deep Model Predictive Variable Impedance Control
results.abstract: A probabilistic ensemble learns Cartesian response under variable impedance through uncertainty-seeking exploration, and cross-entropy MPC adapts stiffness across tasks; the reported method is offline or fine-tuned, unconstrained, normal-contact-discontinuity agnostic, and lacks passivity or safety guarantees.
